title: Basic skills of a receptionist
competency: Explain the procedures and skills for welcoming and assisting visitors.

keywords.def: An office support worker at the front desk who welcomes visitors, answers calls, sets appointments and keeps records.
Handling several tasks at once, such as phone calls and visitors, and deciding what comes first.
Dealing with limits outside your control, such as little time, few resources or sudden problems.

en.text: A receptionist works at the front desk. In Ethiopia the job is mostly in hotels. Duties include answering questions about the company, directing visitors, handling mail and answering calls. Seven basic skills: clear written and verbal communication, customer service, multitasking and prioritising, welcoming body language, interpersonal skills, working under pressure, and basic computer knowledge.

screens.title: Busy front desk
screens.ask: A guest walks in while two phones are ringing. What skill does the receptionist need most right now?
screens.after: Receptionists often handle calls and walk-in visitors at the same time.

screens.title: Duties of a receptionist
paras: Answer visitors' questions about the company and its products or services.
Answer incoming calls on multi-line telephones.
Also: set appointments, file and keep records.

screens.title: Seven basic skills
paras: a. Written and verbal communication: clear and effective.
b. Customer service: pleasant, accommodating, attentive; a smile and the right answer.
c. Multitasking and prioritising: calls, people on hold and visitors at once.
d. Welcoming body language: smiling, nodding, shaking hands, waving.
e. Interpersonal skills: work with others, accept criticism gracefully, friendliness.
f. Working under pressure: little time, few resources, sudden problems.
g. Basic computer knowledge: email, Word, Excel, photocopiers, phone systems.

screens.text: Match each situation with the skill it needs.
pairs: Typing an email to a client
Smiling and nodding at a guest
Staying calm when the system breaks at a busy time
Explaining clearly where the office is

screens.text: Part of a receptionist's job is to direct callers or visitors to the right person.
A good receptionist should give every visitor a professional welcome, no matter who they are.
screens.why: Receptionists should be pleasant, accommodating and attentive to everyone.

screens.text: What makes you a good fit for a receptionist?
A visitor complains rudely about a late delivery. Which response best shows the receptionist's skills?
opts: Listen calmly, apologise, and connect the visitor with the right staff member
screens.ans: Listen calmly, apologise, and connect the visitor with the right staff member
screens.why: This uses customer service, working under pressure, and connecting visitors with the right employees.
